ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey regions to low-intensity black/dark-grey regions across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity regions localized on the distal portions of the left and right lobes. The central region extending from the peduncle is a contiguous low-intensity black field. Significant black mottling and linear interruptions are distributed throughout the white distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with an interior angle of approximately 105 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing edge topography. The left lobe exhibits a series of small, high-frequency serrations. The right lobe features larger, broader undulations and peaks towards the distal tip, isolated against the grey water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to sharply defined and slightly hooked distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, off-white circular protrusions (consistent with barnacle colonization) are localized at the extreme distal tips and along the leading edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned, dark linear streaks (rake marks) crossing the high-intensity white fields on both lobes, primarily oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle clusters at the lobe tips. Several small, circular, low-contrast spots are visible on the dark central surface of the fluke.
